function.name: so101_doctor
function.description: Health check of python, motors, camera, calibration. Read-only: never moves the arm.

function.name: so101_detect
function.description: What the camera sees for the given colours, with robot coordinates. Read-only: never moves the arm.

function.name: so101_report
function.description: Trial metrics per task (detection, grasp, success, error, cycle time, failures). Read-only: never moves the arm.

function.name: so101_agent_start
function.description: Start a task in the background. args examples: ['basket','--trials','3'], ['draw'], ['calibrate','table'], ['doctor','--measure'], ['stack','--hover'], ['demo']. MOVES THE ARM: only after the human's explicit go-ahead in the conversation.

function.name: so101_agent_wait
function.description: Block until the running task asks a question or ends. Returns JSON {state, prompt, options, events}. Read-only: never moves the arm.

function.name: so101_agent_status
function.description: Current state/prompt/events of the running task. Read-only: never moves the arm.

function.name: so101_agent_answer
function.description: Answer the task's current prompt. Human-only prompts (physical confirmations, heights, 'touch') must come from the human. MOVES THE ARM: only after the human's explicit go-ahead in the conversation.

function.name: so101_agent_stop
function.description: Stop the running task's motion immediately. Always allowed.

function.name: read_doc
function.description: Read a framework file: AGENTS.md, docs/PROCEDURES.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, profiles/<name>/robot.yaml, runs/<name>/report.md, runs/<name>/doctor_report.json. Read-only: never moves the arm.
